import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;

    static class ModInt {
        int x;
        ModInt() { x = 0; }
        ModInt(int sig) {
            int sigt = sig % MOD;
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        ModInt(long sig) {
            int sigt = (int)(sig % MOD);
            if (sigt < 0) sigt += MOD;
            x = sigt;
        }
        int get() { return x; }
        ModInt add(ModInt that) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x);
            res.x += that.x;
            if (res.x >= MOD) res.x -= MOD;
            return res;
        }
        ModInt sub(ModInt that) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x);
            res.x += MOD - that.x;
            if (res.x >= MOD) res.x -= MOD;
            return res;
        }
        ModInt mul(ModInt that) {
            ModInt res = new ModInt(this.x);
            res.x = (int)((long)this.x * that.x % MOD);
            return res;
        }
        void addAssign(ModInt that) {
            x += that.x;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
        }
        void subAssign(ModInt that) {
            x += MOD - that.x;
            if (x >= MOD) x -= MOD;
        }
        void mulAssign(ModInt that) {
            x = (int)((long)x * that.x % MOD);
        }
    }

    static class Matrix {
        int n, m;
        ModInt[][] v;
        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = m;
            v = new ModInt[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    v[i][j] = new ModInt(0);
        }
        int height() { return n; }
        int width() { return m; }
        ModInt at(int i, int j) { return v[i][j]; }
        void set(int i, int j, ModInt val) { v[i][j] = val; }
        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix A = new Matrix(n, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                A.v[i][i] = new ModInt(1);
            return A;
        }
        Matrix transpose() {
            Matrix T = new Matrix(m, n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++)
                    T.v[j][i] = v[i][j];
            return T;
        }
        void multiplyAssign(Matrix B) {
            int n = this.n, m = B.m, p = B.n;
            ModInt[][] w = new ModInt[n][m];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    ModInt sum = new ModInt(0);
                    for (int k = 0; k < p; k++) {
                        sum.addAssign(v[i][k].mul(B.v[k][j]));
                    }
                    w[i][j] = sum;
                }
            }
            v = w;
        }
        static Matrix pow(Matrix A, long k) {
            Matrix result = identity(A.n);
            Matrix base = A;
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) != 0) result.multiplyAssign(base);
                base.multiplyAssign(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }
    }

    static Matrix getRotateMatrix(int k, int t) {
        t = (t % k + k) % k;
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
            A.v[i][(i + t) % k] = new ModInt(1);
        A.v[k][k] = new ModInt(1);
        A.v[k+1][k+1] = new ModInt(1);
        A.v[k+2][k+2] = new ModInt(1);
        return A;
    }

    static Matrix getSingletonMatrix(int k, int j) {
        Matrix A = new Matrix(k + 3, k + 3);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            if (i != j)
                A.v[i][i].addAssign(new ModInt(1));
        }
        A.v[k+1][k+1] = new ModInt(1);
        A.v[k+2][k+2] = new ModInt(1);
        A.v[k][k+1].addAssign(new ModInt(1));
        A.v[j][k+1].subAssign(new ModInt(1));
        A.v[k][k].addAssign(new ModInt(2));
        A.v[j][k].subAssign(new ModInt(1));
        A.v[k][j].addAssign(new ModInt(1));
        return A;
    }

    static int s_k(int k, long j) {
        long t = j;
        int u = 0;
        while (t > 0) {
            u = (u + (int)(t % k)) % k;
            t /= k;
        }
        return u;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        while (sc.hasNextLong()) {
            long n = sc.nextLong();
            int k = sc.nextInt();
            // column vector (k+3 x 1)
            Matrix b = new Matrix(k + 3, 1);
            b.v[k][0] = new ModInt(1);
            b.v[k+1][0] = new ModInt(1);
            b.v[k+2][0] = new ModInt(1);

            long powk = 1;
            int digits = 0;
            while (powk <= n / k) {
                powk *= k;
                digits++;
            }

            List<Matrix> P = new ArrayList<>(digits + 1);
            P.add(getSingletonMatrix(k, 0));
            for (int i = 1; i <= digits; i++) {
                Matrix cur = Matrix.identity(k + 3);
                for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) {
                    cur.multiplyAssign(P.get(i-1));
                    cur.multiplyAssign(getRotateMatrix(k, -1));
                }
                P.add(cur);
            }

            List<Matrix> P_trans = new ArrayList<>(digits + 1);
            for (int i = 0; i <= digits; i++) {
                P_trans.add(P.get(i).transpose());
            }

            long offset = 0;
            while (powk > 0) {
                int t = (int)((n - offset) / powk);
                for (int j = 0; j < t; j++) {
                    int s = s_k(k, offset);
                    Matrix R1 = getRotateMatrix(k, -s).transpose();
                    Matrix R2 = getRotateMatrix(k, s).transpose();
                    // b = R2 * (P_trans[digits] * (R1 * b))
                    Matrix temp = R1;
                    temp.multiplyAssign(b);
                    temp = P_trans.get(digits);
                    temp.multiplyAssign(b); // wait, need to compute correctly
                    // Actually we need to compute step by step:
                    // b = R2 * (P_trans[digits] * (R1 * b))
                    // Let's do:
                    Matrix temp1 = R1;
                    temp1.multiplyAssign(b);
                    Matrix temp2 = P_trans.get(digits);
                    temp2.multiplyAssign(temp1);
                    Matrix temp3 = R2;
                    temp3.multiplyAssign(temp2);
                    b = temp3;
                    offset += powk;
                }
                powk /= k;
                digits--;
            }

            ModInt ans = b.v[k+1][0];
            System.out.println(ans.get());
        }
        sc.close();
    }
}
